description: Tuning parameters for health evaluation, anomaly detection, trend prediction and diagnosis. Every value here is a TEAM ESTIMATE to be tuned against generated scenarios. The detector's physical models below are its own 'datasheet' beliefs; they start equal to config/generator.json but are deliberately kept separate so the detector never reads the generator's truth.

evaluation.notes: Evaluate once per 60 s batch. Judge a rolling-median-smoothed value, not single raw samples. Skip per_mode relative checks for 30 s after a mode change (current spikes while the robot starts or stops). Hard limits are never skipped.

anomaly.notes: Raise an anomaly only after 5 consecutive smoothed samples are past a limit (debounce against noise). Consider it cleared after 30 consecutive normal samples. Do not raise the same robot+channel+severity again within 600 s. Main defence against false positives that waste P5 capacity.

trend.notes: Fit the last 30 min of the deviation-from-baseline signal. Only extrapolate when the fit is good (R^2 >= 0.6) and the slope is at least 3 standard errors from zero. Report time-to-failure as the time the trend crosses the CRITICAL limit, with an 80% interval. Ignore predicted crossings more than 4 h away.

predictive_warning.notes: Issue a predictive warning when predicted time-to-failure is under 60 min with confidence >= 0.6. HUNCH's excellence example is 15 min (900 s) of lead time; we tune toward more.

thermal_model.notes: Used for (1) the lagged thermal baseline and (2) the thermal residual: predicted T from measured current and speed, P = I^2 R + tau_b * omega, first-order lag to sink + P * R_th.

battery_model.notes: Baseline for battery_voltage_v = V_oc(SOC) - I * r_int_nominal. Linear interpolation in the table.

diagnosis.notes: Thresholds for turning each signature element (UP / DOWN / NORMAL / EXPLAINED_BY_CURRENT in config/faults.json) into a yes/no observation over the last 30 min. The diagnosis scores each of the four faults by how many signature elements match. Below min_confidence the fault mode is reported as 'unknown'.

severity_rules.notes: Severity is WARNING or CRITICAL. CRITICAL if predicted time-to-failure < 30 min or any evidence channel is already CRITICAL.

health_score.notes: Robot health_score (0-100) = minimum of subsystem scores; subsystem score = points for its worst channel status. Placeholder rule - refine after PDR.
